summary.summary: At 2026-01-24T01:50:00Z the auth-service raised a high‑severity credential‑stuffing alert. In the preceding hour 32 distinct usernames failed to log in from 31 different sources, far exceeding the learned baseline of ~0.7 failures (z‑score 31.3). This represents an abnormal surge in failed login attempts, orders of magnitude above normal activity.
summary.likely_trigger: A credential‑stuffing attack targeting auth-service, evidenced by many failed usernames from many sources in a short window.
summary.suggested_next_check: Review the raw authentication logs for the affected hour to identify the source IPs and patterns, and verify that rate‑limiting or lockout controls are active.
